(function() {
    const topBar = document.querySelector('.elementor-element-80f69f9');
    const navBar = document.querySelector('.elementor-element-5ed4100');
    
    if (!topBar || !navBar) return;
    
    let topBarHeight = topBar.offsetHeight;
    let lastScrollTop = 0;
    let isSticky = false;
    
    // Remove any existing Elementor sticky
    navBar.classList.remove('elementor-sticky');
    navBar.style.position = '';
    navBar.style.top = '';
    
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
        let scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
        
        if (scrollTop > topBarHeight) {
            // Make nav sticky and hide top bar
            if (!isSticky) {
                navBar.style.position = 'fixed';
                navBar.style.top = '0';
                navBar.style.left = '0';
                navBar.style.right = '0';
                navBar.style.zIndex = '9999';
                navBar.style.transition = 'all 0.3s ease';
                isSticky = true;
            }
            
            // Hide top bar with smooth transition
            topBar.style.transform = 'translateY(-100%)';
            topBar.style.transition = 'transform 0.3s ease';
            
        } else {
            // Back to top - restore original state
            navBar.style.position = '';
            navBar.style.top = '';
            navBar.style.left = '';
            navBar.style.right = '';
            isSticky = false;
            
            // Show top bar
            topBar.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        }
        
        lastScrollTop = scrollTop;
    });
